'''2020 TMW Pods Justin Miyashiro LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Miyashiro]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
